subject: Scheduling: On-site workshop + Exec dinner during Cloud Summit — Acme Finance
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Zhang <olivia.zhang@acme-finance.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@cloudops.acme.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Oct 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: On-site workshop + exec dinner during Cloud Summit week

Hi Olivia / Daniel —

Great speaking with Olivia last week. As we discussed, Redwood would love to run a focused on-site workshop for Acme Finance engineers and an executive dinner while we are both attending Cloud Summit (Nov 11–13 in San Francisco). Goal: hands-on integration workshop (2–3 hours) for eng/procurement/security, plus an executive dinner for your leadership + our execs to align on deployment strategy and timeline.

Proposed agenda/options:
- Workshop: Nov 12 or Nov 13, 2:00–5:00pm (half-day lab + Q&A). SE-led lab, bring a small test dataset and our infra kit.
- Exec dinner: Nov 12, 7:00–9:00pm (restaurant near Moscone) — small room/reserve for up to 10.

Questions for you to confirm so we can lock logistics:
1) Preferred workshop date/time? (Nov 12 afternoon preferred by our SE)
2) Rough headcount (execs vs engineers vs procurement/security).
3) Any security/VPN/guest-badging constraints Daniel should know about.
4) Procurement timeline / whether we should bring a redlined MSA or route via DocuSign.

I’ve attached a draft mutual action plan to map owners and milestones. Ava (cc) will run the lab; Marcus (cc) is available for executive discussion. Monica on CS will coordinate post-demo onboarding.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once we have a date.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Acme_Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.pdf
From: Olivia Zhang <olivia.zhang@acme-finance.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Bhavna Kapoor <bhavna.kapoor@acme-finance.com>, Acme Finance - Procurements <procure@acme-finance.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@cloudops.acme.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Oct 2025 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-site workshop + exec dinner during Cloud Summit week

Diego — thanks for the note and the MAP. Sounds useful. Quick answers:

1) Workshop: Nov 12 afternoon works best for engineering (2:00–5:00pm).
2) Headcount: Exec dinner — 6 Acme execs + 2 Redwood execs (TBD). Workshop — ~3 Acme engineers + 2 security engineers + 1 procurement observer.
3) Security: Daniel (cc) will confirm badge/visitor process; we do require advance names for building access and a short network breakout for demo VMs (we can give a jump host and limited egress).
4) Procurement: Bhavna (cc) is our procurement lead — she will need a redline of the MSA and SOC2 summary before signature. Procurement typically needs two weeks after receiving final MSA.

A couple of constraints: our CFO travel schedule is tight on Nov 12 evening; would it be possible to hold the exec dinner on Nov 11 evening instead if that makes it easier? If not, Nov 12 still acceptable but may be shorter (7–8:15pm).

We’ll aim to provide the final headcount and names by Nov 7 for badges.

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Zhang
Director of Engineering | Acme Finance

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Zhang <olivia.zhang@acme-finance.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On-site workshop + exec dinner during Cloud Summit week

Hi Olivia / team —

Thanks — happy Nov 12 (2–5pm) is an option. A few quick ops notes from the SE side:
- I’ll bring a laptop kit, local inference runtime container, and a ~10k-token sample dataset. Could you please share a small schema or sample logs for tokenization checks (PII-safe) so we can prep fixtures?
- AV / room needs: projector + HDMI, whiteboard, table power. If we’re in your office, we’ll need one network jump-host + outbound ports 443 and 22 enabled for a short session (~30 mins) to pull model weights. If the building requires specific IP allowlisting, please let Daniel know.
- For the hands-on lab I suggest three stations (pair-programming) and a short pre-lab install checklist — I’ll share that as draft invite attachment.

I’ve attached a campus map and a draft invite (.ics) for the exec dinner; please feel free to edit time/location. Monica (cc) will follow up on travel/expensing that Redwood execs may need for the dinner.

Cheers,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: CloudSummit_Onsite_Map.png, draft-invite.ics
From: Bhavna Kapoor <bhavna.kapoor@acme-finance.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Olivia Zhang <olivia.zhang@acme-finance.com>
Cc: Acme Finance - Procurements <procure@acme-finance.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 11:15:00 -0800

Diego / Olivia —

Procurement note: we’ve reviewed the MAP and the preliminary MSA you shared earlier. Two asks before we can route to legal for final sign-off:
1) Please send a redline of the MSA with the sections on data handling and indemnity updated (we’ll need SOC2 summary to confirm controls).
2) Given our CFO’s schedule, can we consider moving the workshop to Nov 13 (afternoon) instead of Nov 12? Execs are flexible on dinner timing — Nov 11 evening would be ideal for them.

If you can provide a redline by Nov 14 we can push legal/finance to complete review by Nov 28. If timeline slips, we may need to move the workshop to the week after Cloud Summit.

Thanks — Bhavna
Head of Procurement | Acme Finance

Subject: Final: Workshop moved to Nov 13 (2–5pm); Exec dinner Nov 12 at 7:00pm

Thanks everyone for the quick coordination — summary and final asks below. Forwarding the MAP and SOC2 summary for procurement/legal review (attached).

Final schedule (confirmed):
- Executive dinner: Nov 12, 7:00pm–9:00pm — Reserve: Bodega Room, The Harbor House (address in attached map). Redwood execs: Marcus Lin (SVP Product) + myself. Acme execs: Olivia + 5 others (please send names for badges).
- Workshop (hands-on lab): Nov 13, 2:00–5:00pm — Acme HQ, 3rd floor conference room. SE: Ava Chen. Headcount: 3 Acme engineers, 2 security, 1 procurement observer, 3 Redwood (SE/CS).

Logistics / action items:
- Bhavna: please confirm preferred contract redline recipient and we’ll upload to DocuSign. We aim to have redline to you by EOD Nov 14.
- Daniel: please confirm badge process and whether an IP allowlist is required for the short port access.
- Olivia: please share sample schema/anonymized logs by Nov 10 (if not available, we’ll run a generic tokenization pass).
- Monica: I’ll need travel/expense process for the Redwood execs for dinner reimbursement; Monica will follow up separately.

Files attached: Acme_Mutual_Action_Plan_v3.pdf, Redwood_Soc2_Summary.pdf, CloudSummit_Onsite_Map.png, draft-invite.ics
